text:
About **0.5 hectares of mapped native forest** overlapped with tree-cover loss in 2022. The total mapped loss event was 0.6 hectares, or 3.41% of the 17.6-hectare property; the remaining 0.1 hectares was outside mapped forest.

An additional 0.2 hectares of tree-cover loss occurred in smaller patches, but was not counted as an event. The evidence does not establish the cause of the loss or whether it involved deforestation or land-use change.
